summary.text: Misti Meehan is the Democratic candidate for the Indiana House of Representatives, District 84, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Bob Morris.
A small business owner and former Army National Guard member, she lists affordability, public education and government accountability among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Misti Meehan served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 1996 to 2004, graduated from Northrop High School, and earned bachelor's degrees from Indiana University-Purdue University Fort Wayne in 2003 and 2014.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born and raised in Fort Wayne, holds degrees in political science and public affairs, and has worked elections as a canvasser, clerk and judge.
She said she runs her own business.
Meehan ran for Fort Wayne City Council District 1 in 2019 and lost the general election to incumbent Paul Ensley.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for Indiana House District 84 on May 5, 2026, without a primary opponent.

In her survey, she said her first priority is lowering everyday costs, including housing, utilities, child care, health care, transportation and taxes, and that she supports fully supporting public schools and expanding early learning and child care.
